payload.summary_zh: GEOFlow 3.2.0-beta.2 新增专题管理与 AI 专题任务、三种专题阅读布局和精简模板库，补充 GEO 发现文件、模板视频支持，并修复文章批量操作、AI 按分数放行与自动发布流程。
payload.summary_en: GEOFlow 3.2.0-beta.2 adds topic management and AI topic tasks, three topic reading layouts, and an organized theme library, alongside GEO discovery files, theme video support, and fixes for article bulk actions, score-based AI quality approval, and automatic publication.
payload.upgrade_tip_zh: 本预览版用于开发与隔离测试，尚未完成正式签名分发、原生双架构恢复演练或生产部署验收。配套使用 CLI 0.4.0-preview.2、Skill 1.2.0-preview.2，以及声明兼容本 Core 契约的 Updater 构建。从 beta.1 升级新增 9 项维护模式迁移，升级前备份数据库、模板与配置，排空旧 worker 并构建前端资源；使用模板视频需安装 ffprobe。旧质检报告需重新检查，历史保留文章不会自动发布；API/CLI 创建普通文章任务须显式提供 need_review。已受管实例恢复后继续保持恢复限制，先查询原操作收据并完成逐业务对账；响应不确定时不要自动重发。主题草稿编辑与预览已开放，远程主题发布和回滚仍待后续版本。生产环境继续使用最新稳定版 3.1.0。
payload.upgrade_tip_en: This preview is for development and isolated testing. Official signed distribution, native dual-architecture recovery rehearsals, and production deployment acceptance remain pending. Use CLI 0.4.0-preview.2, Skill 1.2.0-preview.2, and an Updater build declaring compatibility with this Core contract. Upgrading from beta.1 adds nine maintenance-mode migrations: back up the database, themes, and configuration, drain old workers, and build frontend assets. Theme video support requires ffprobe. Recheck older AI quality reports; existing held articles stay held. API/CLI creation of article tasks requires an explicit need_review field. Keep managed instances held after recovery, query the original operation receipt, and reconcile each business domain; do not automatically resend uncertain requests. Theme draft editing and preview are available; remote theme publication and rollback remain pending. Production environments should continue using stable 3.1.0.
